company.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
company.industry: Internet / AI / Social Media / Metaverse (Reality Labs)
company.primary_assets: Servers, Network Infrastructure, Data Centers, GPU Clusters, Operating Lease ROU Assets
company.coverage_note: 本10-K覆盖FY2022（2022-01-01至2022-12-31），审计报告日期2023-02-01（HTML L4713），EDGAR提交日2023-02-02。2022年为元宇宙重投入年：Reality Labs经营亏损$13.72B；2022年11月宣布裁员约11,000人；Q3起设施整合+数据中心战略转向，全年重组费用$4.61B；同年Q2/Q4两次延长服务器折旧年限（4→4.5→5年），减少折旧$860M、增加净利润$693M。

financial_highlights.capex_note: MD&A口径：'Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $32.04 billion'（HTML L3547）。另有净购买口径'$31.19 billion of net purchases of property and equipment'（L4356）。两个口径capex/收入均>25%。
financial_highlights.depreciation_note: Note 8：'Depreciation expense on property and equipment was $8.50 billion'（HTML L5300）。现金流量表D&A合计$8.69B（L4351）。
financial_highlights.amortization_note: 推算值：现金流量表D&A $8.69B 减 PP&E折旧 $8.50B（10-K未单独列示无形资产摊销行）。
financial_highlights.impairment_charges_note: 2022年非现金减值/废弃合计$3.56B（MD&A L4351：'impairment for leases, leasehold improvements, and abandonment charges for data center assets'），构成：$2.22B经营租赁ROU+租赁装修减值（L5054，其中ROU $1.71B见L5320）+ $1.34B数据中心在建工程(CIP)废弃（L4995/L5307，ASC 360）+ $508M数据中心资产及装修减值（L5307，含于$2.22B内）。重组总费用$4.61B另含遣散费$975M（Note 3 L5225）。
financial_highlights.capex_prior_year_note: NA - 本次核对未在文中提取2021年同口径capex数值（2021净购买PP&E见现金流量表三年期表，未逐字核录）。

accounting_policy.change_in_estimate_method: prospectively (based on servers and network assets existing as of the effective dates of the changes; no retrospective adjustment)
accounting_policy.policy_risk_note: ⚠️核心风险画像：Meta在2022年同一年内做了两件方向相反的事——(1) Q2/Q4两次延长服务器折旧年限（4→4.5→5年），称'expected longer refresh cycles'，机械性减少折旧$860M、增厚净利润$693M（占全年净利润3.0%），未来适用不追溯；(2) Q4以AI为由'pivot...to a next generation design'并取消多个数据中心项目，确认$1.34B在建数据中心资产废弃+$3.56B总减值/废弃。一边假设既有服务器/网络资产用得更久，一边承认数据中心资产实体上需要提前报废重建——折旧年限假设与同期实际资产处置行为直接矛盾。Note 1同时承认'technological advancements'可使实际寿命偏离估计且变更仅未来适用（L4996-5005），历史少提折旧永不修正。

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies - Use of Estimates
risk_signals.keyword_matched: extended the estimated average useful lives of a majority of the servers and network assets from four years to 4.5 years
risk_signals.text_excerpt: In connection with our periodic reviews of the estimated useful lives of property and equipment, we extended the estimated average useful lives of a majority of the servers and network assets from four years to 4.5 years, effective the second quarter of 2022, and further extended the useful lives to five years effective the fourth quarter of 2022. The changes in estimated useful lives were due to expected longer refresh cycles in our data centers. The financial impact of the changes was a reduction in depreciation expense of $860 million and an increase in net income of $693 million, or $0.26 per diluted share for the year ended December 31, 2022. The impact from the changes in our estimates was calculated based on the servers and network assets existing as of the effective dates of the changes and applying the revised estimated useful lives prospectively.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies - Use of Estimates (HTML lines 4744-4754)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: This is the single most important signal in the 2022 10-K and the exact behavior the project targets: Meta extended server/network useful lives TWICE within fiscal 2022 (4->4.5 years in Q2, 4.5->5 years in Q4), mechanically cutting depreciation by $860M and inflating net income by $693M (~3.0% of 2022 net income of $23,200M), applied prospectively so prior under-depreciation is never corrected. The stated reason ('expected longer refresh cycles') is contradicted by the same filing's disclosure that Meta abandoned $1.34B of data center construction-in-progress in Q4 2022 (SIG-005/SIG-007).
evidence_chain: Official disclosure: servers/network assets 4->4.5 years effective Q2 2022, then ->5 years effective Q4 2022
Quantified effect: -$860M depreciation expense, +$693M net income (+$0.26/diluted share) for FY2022
Applied prospectively to assets existing at the effective dates; no restatement of prior periods
Stated rationale: 'expected longer refresh cycles in our data centers'
Same 10-K (Note 3, L5220-5225): in December 2022 Meta pivoted data center projects to a 'next generation design' and canceled multiple projects, triggering $1.34B abandonment charges
Contradiction: accounting assumes longer asset life while management simultaneously scraps data center assets early for a new design
Result: FY2022 reported net income of $23,200M embeds a $693M one-off estimate-change benefit; historical under-depreciation permanently uncorrected

risk_signals.source: Item 7. MD&A - Critical Accounting Estimates - Valuation of Long-lived Assets and Estimated Useful Lives
risk_signals.keyword_matched: reduction in depreciation expense of $860 million and an increase in net income of $693 million
risk_signals.text_excerpt: The current estimate of useful lives represents our best estimate based on current facts and circumstances, but may differ from the actual useful lives due to changes in future circumstances such as changes to our business operations, changes in the planned use of assets, and technological advancements. When we change the estimated useful life assumption for any asset, the remaining carrying amount of the asset is accounted for prospectively and depreciated or amortized over the revised remaining useful life. In connection with our periodic reviews of the estimated useful lives of property and equipment, we extended the estimated average useful lives of our servers and network assets category effective the second and the fourth quarters of 2022.
risk_signals.page_location: Item 7. MD&A - Critical Accounting Estimates (HTML lines 4049-4069); same change also quantified here at lines 4065-4069
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: The useful-life extension is material enough to be disclosed twice (MD&A Critical Accounting Estimates AND Note 1) — Meta itself treats it as a critical accounting estimate. The MD&A passage explicitly concedes that 'technological advancements' may make actual lives differ from estimates, and that changes are prospective only, in the same breath as announcing the lengthening.
evidence_chain: Management designates long-lived asset valuation/useful lives as a Critical Accounting Estimate
Same paragraph admits estimates may differ from actual lives due to 'technological advancements'
Correction mechanism is one-directional in effect: remaining carrying amount depreciated over the REVISED (longer) life, prior years never trued-up
The change disclosed in this critical-estimate section is a lengthening that reduced expense, not a shortening
Result: the most judgment-sensitive estimate in the filing moved in the profit-increasing direction during a year of collapsing operating margin (40%->25%)

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 1. Property and Equipment - Useful Life Table
risk_signals.keyword_matched: Servers and network assets / Four to Five years

risk_signals.page_location: Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies - Property and Equipment, useful life table (HTML line 4988)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Post-change official schedule: after the two 2022 extensions, the fastest-obsolescing asset class (servers and network assets, gross $34,330M at year-end 2022, +34.2% YoY) is depreciated straight-line over 4-5 years. Against a 1-2 year AI hardware iteration cycle (H100 2022 -> B100 2024), the accounting life spans 2-5 technology generations. This is the identical anchor as the confirmed 2023 annotation (4-5 years).
evidence_chain: Official server depreciation life after 2022 changes: 4-5 years (straight-line)
GPU/AI hardware cycle: ~1-2 years per generation (H100 2022 -> B100 2024 -> B200 2025)
Life mismatch ratio 2.0-2.5x (same measurement convention as confirmed 2023 annotation)
Servers and network assets gross grew $25,584M -> $34,330M (+34.2%) during 2022 - the newest cohort is depreciated under the just-extended life
Result: a growing share of the asset base carries the extended-life assumption

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 1. Property and Equipment
risk_signals.text_excerpt: Our current estimate of useful lives represents the best estimate of the useful lives based on current facts and circumstances, but may differ from the actual useful lives due to changes to our business operations, changes in the planned use of assets, and technological advancements. When we change the estimated useful life assumption for any asset, the remaining carrying amount of the asset is accounted for prospectively and depreciated or amortized over the revised estimated useful life.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies - Property and Equipment (HTML lines 4996-5005)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Same anchor text as confirmed 2023 annotation (META-2023-SIG-004): Meta explicitly acknowledges that technological advancements may shorten actual useful lives, yet corrections are prospective-only, so historical under-depreciation is never corrected. In 2022 this policy language coexists with an actual lengthening of lives - the asymmetry (lengthen immediately, never shorten retrospectively) is the systematic bias the project measures.
evidence_chain: Company admits: 'technological advancements' may cause actual lives to differ from estimates
When lives change, remaining book value is depreciated over the NEW life (prospectively)
Historical depreciation taken at the OLD rate is NOT adjusted
In 2022 the only change made was an extension (expense down), despite the acknowledged technology risk pointing the other way
Result: systematic understatement of depreciation in early years; systematic overstatement of profit, uncorrected by design

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 1. Property and Equipment - Impairment
risk_signals.keyword_matched: abandonment charges for data center construction in progress (CIP) assets
risk_signals.text_excerpt: We evaluate at least annually the recoverability of property and equipment for possible impairment whenever events or circumstances indicate that the carrying amount of such assets may not be recoverable. If such review indicates that the carrying amount of property and equipment assets is not recoverable, and the asset's fair value is less than the carrying amount, an impairment charge is recognized. During the year ended December 31, 2022, we recorded $1.34 billion of abandonment charges for data center construction in progress (CIP) assets under Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) Topic 360 related to our restructuring efforts.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies - Property and Equipment (HTML lines 4990-4995)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Realized write-off INSIDE the depreciation base: $1.34B of data center construction-in-progress was abandoned outright in 2022. CIP is not yet depreciated, so this is pure capital destruction that never passed through the depreciation schedule at all - direct proof that data center asset values evaporate faster than plan, in the same year management extended depreciation lives citing 'longer refresh cycles'.
evidence_chain: PP&E impairment test exists but triggers only on 'events or circumstances'
2022 actual event: $1.34B of data center CIP abandoned under ASC 360
CIP never depreciated -> the loss bypassed the depreciation schedule entirely
The abandonment was caused by a strategy pivot to 'next generation design' for AI (Note 3, SIG-007) - i.e., technological obsolescence of the in-flight buildout
Same year: server useful lives extended 4->5 years (expense down $860M)
Result: accounting system recognized the good news (longer life) immediately and the bad news (obsolete builds) as a one-off charge, never as higher run-rate depreciation

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 1. Leases - Impairment
risk_signals.keyword_matched: impairment losses of $2.22 billion in aggregate for operating lease ROU assets and leasehold improvements
risk_signals.text_excerpt: During the year ended December 31, 2022, we recorded impairment losses of $2.22 billion in aggregate for operating lease ROU assets and leasehold improvements under ASC Topic 360 as a part of our facilities consolidation restructuring efforts. The fair values of the impaired assets were estimated using discounted cash flow models (income approach) based on market participant assumptions with Level 3 inputs.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 1. Summary of Significant Accounting Policies - Leases (HTML line 5054)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Second realized write-down of the year: $2.22B of operating-lease ROU assets and leasehold improvements impaired (fair value estimated with Level 3 inputs). Leasehold improvements are depreciated/amortized assets; their impairment demonstrates that actual useful economic life ended years before the lease-term-based amortization schedule assumed.
evidence_chain: Leasehold improvements amortized over 'lesser of estimated useful life or remaining lease term' (L4988)
2022 actual: $2.22B impairment of ROU assets + leasehold improvements (facilities consolidation)
Fair value had to be modeled with Level 3 inputs - no market corroboration of remaining value
These assets were being amortized on schedules that assumed continued use through lease term
Result: amortization schedules again proved optimistic vs. actual asset abandonment timing

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 3. Restructuring
risk_signals.keyword_matched: pivot several of our data center building projects to a next generation design while also canceling multiple existing data center projects
risk_signals.text_excerpt: In December 2022, we reevaluated our data center investment strategy to improve efficiency and further advance our efforts around artificial intelligence. As a result, we decided to pivot several of our data center building projects to a next generation design while also canceling multiple existing data center projects. This strategy led to abandonment charges of the related data center assets. ... Restructuring charges for the year ended December 31, 2022: Facilities Consolidation $2,295M; Severance and Other Personnel Costs $975M; Data Center Assets $1,341M; Total $4,611M.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 3. Restructuring (HTML lines 5210-5226); identical narrative and table in MD&A Overview (HTML lines 3537-3556)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: The causal statement the project needs: AI ('further advance our efforts around artificial intelligence') is WHY data center projects were canceled mid-build. Technology evolution forced abandonment of $1.34B of in-flight data center assets in Q4 2022 - the quarter AFTER Meta extended server lives citing 'longer refresh cycles'. Total 2022 restructuring $4.61B cut operating margin by four percentage points and diluted EPS by $1.34.
evidence_chain: Q2 2022: server life extended 4->4.5 years ('longer refresh cycles')
Q4 2022: server life further extended to 5 years
December 2022: multiple data center projects canceled/pivoted to next-gen AI design; $1.34B abandonment
The abandoned projects were designed under the OLD generation assumptions - their useful life ended before completion
Same logic applies to deployed servers: a 'next generation design' for AI implies shorter economic life for current-generation assets
Result: depreciation assumptions (5 years) and demonstrated asset-planning reality (abandon before completion) are irreconcilable within one reporting year

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 8. Property and Equipment
risk_signals.keyword_matched: Depreciation expense on property and equipment was $8.50 billion
risk_signals.text_excerpt: Depreciation expense on property and equipment was $8.50 billion, $7.56 billion, and $6.39 billion for the years ended December 31, 2022, 2021, and 2020, respectively. The majority of the property and equipment depreciation expense was from servers and network assets depreciation of $5.29 billion, $4.94 billion, and $4.38 billion for the years ended December 31, 2022, 2021, and 2020, respectively. ... During the year ended December 31, 2022, we recorded $1.34 billion abandonment charge and $508 million impairment loss for data center assets and leasehold improvements assets, respectively, as a result of our restructuring efforts.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 8. Property and Equipment (HTML lines 5296-5308); PP&E table at line 5296: Servers and network assets $34,330M (2022) vs $25,584M (2021); Construction in progress $25,052M vs $14,687M; gross $104,493M; accumulated depreciation $(24,975)M; net $79,518M
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Quantifies the leverage: servers/network depreciation $5.29B = 62.2% of total PP&E depreciation $8.50B, so any error in the server life assumption dominates the depreciation line. Despite the $860M extension benefit, depreciation still rose 12.4% YoY because the asset base exploded (servers gross +34.2% to $34,330M; CIP +70.6% to $25,052M). The $25B CIP cohort has not started depreciating - a guaranteed future expense step-up, or the next candidate for another life extension.
evidence_chain: Server depreciation share of total: 62.2% ($5.29B / $8.50B) - single assumption dominates
Servers and network assets gross +34.2% YoY; CIP (future depreciable base) +70.6% YoY to $25,052M
Depreciation growth would have been materially higher without the $860M extension benefit
Same note records $1.34B abandonment + $508M impairment - write-offs alongside a lengthened schedule
Result: depreciation line is simultaneously suppressed by estimate changes and about to step up as CIP commissions

risk_signals.text_excerpt: During the year ended December 31, 2022, we also recorded $1.71 billion impairment loss for operating lease ROU assets as a part of our facilities consolidation restructuring efforts.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Corroborating realized impairment within the lease portfolio (component of the $2.22B in SIG-006). The offices/data centers being subleased, early-terminated or abandoned were occupied under assumptions of multi-year utility; their impairment confirms facility-level economic lives ended early, consistent with the data center asset abandonment pattern.
evidence_chain: Operating lease ROU assets amortized over lease terms (weighted-average remaining term 12.5 years)
2022 actual: $1.71B ROU impairment from facilities consolidation
Real estate/facility commitments outlasted their business utility
Result: long-dated facility assumptions (like long server lives) systematically overstate asset durability

risk_signals.source: Item 7. MD&A - Overview and Liquidity and Capital Resources
risk_signals.text_excerpt: Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $32.04 billion for the year ended December 31, 2022. ... Cash provided by operating activities during 2022 mostly consisted of net income adjusted for certain non-cash items, such as $11.99 billion of share-based compensation expense, $8.69 billion of depreciation and amortization, and $3.56 billion of impairment for leases, leasehold improvements, and abandonment charges for data center assets related to our restructuring efforts. ... risk_signals.page_location: Item 7. MD&A - Overview (HTML line 3547) and Liquidity and Capital Resources (HTML lines 4351-4356); Reality Labs disclosure at Item 1A. Risk Factors (HTML line 1560)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Peak asset-intensity year: capex/revenue = 27.5% ($32.04B / $116.6B), above the 25% top anchor band and far above 2023's 20.2%. Simultaneously, $3.56B of impairment/abandonment was added back as non-cash - the income statement both absorbed record write-offs AND was flattered by the $860M depreciation reduction. RL's $13.72B operating loss shows the metaverse investment was consuming the cash flows that fund the server buildout, increasing the odds of future strategic write-offs.
evidence_chain: Capex $32.04B (incl. finance lease principal) = 27.5% of revenue; net PP&E purchases $31.19B = 26.7% - both >25% band
Revenue declined 1% YoY while capex kept rising - intensity spike is denominator-worsened
$3.56B non-cash impairment/abandonment add-back in the same year
RL operating loss $13.72B with 'investments to increase in the future' - ongoing capital commitment with unproven payback
Result: maximum depreciation-assumption leverage in 2022; each 1-year error in server life swings annual expense by ~$1B+

dimension_scores.dimension_name: 折旧年限 vs 技术实际寿命
dimension_scores.dimension_name_en: Depreciation Life vs Technology Useful Life
dimension_scores.reasoning: 锚点与2023确认版一致→4分：服务器折旧年限4-5年（Note 1年限表，L4988），AI硬件迭代周期1-2年（H100 2022→B100 2024），错配比2.0-2.5x（沿用2023口径）。公司在会计政策中明确承认'technological advancements'可能导致实际寿命偏离估计（L4996-5005）。2022年新增事实：年限在本期内由4年经两次变更延至5年（Q2→4.5、Q4→5），方向与技术迭代加速相反，但锚定档位仍为4-5年档，与2023确认版保持同分。

锚点'本期延长年限→5'（2023确认版为4，因2023本期无变更、仅历史有延长）。2022年本期两次延长：Q2由4年延至4.5年、Q4再延至5年（L4744-4754），理由为'expected longer refresh cycles in our data centers'（L4748）；影响量化披露：折旧费用减少$860M、净利润增加$693M（占2022净利润$23,200M的3.0%）、稀释EPS+$0.26，未来适用法不追溯（L4754、L4060-4069）。同一年度内公司在延长折旧年限的同时废弃$1.34B数据中心在建资产（SIG-005），估计裁量呈单向利己特征，达到该维度锚点满分情形。分数变化（4→5）真实反映政策事件差异，非口径漂移。

锚点'本期大额减值→5'（2023确认版为4，本期减值$2.43B设施整合）。2022年本期减值/废弃规模更大且性质更直接：非现金减值+废弃合计$3.56B（L4351），其中$1.34B为数据中心在建工程(CIP)直接废弃（L4995/L5307，ASC 360）、$2.22B为经营租赁ROU+租赁装修减值（L5054，含ROU $1.71B，L5320）、另$508M数据中心资产及装修减值（L5307）；重组总费用$4.61B（Note 3 L5225：设施整合$2,295M+遣散$975M+数据中心资产$1,341M），拉低经营利润率4个百分点、稀释EPS $1.34。触发原因为AI下一代数据中心设计转向+设施整合+裁员11,000人，Risk Factors另有2处直接减值信号（L1434、L1711）。与2023确认版的分数差异（4→5）由三项真实差异支撑：金额更大（$3.56B vs $2.43B）、含折旧基数内PP&E直接废弃、且与年限延长同年发生（矛盾信号同年叠加）。

锚点'capex/收入>25%→5'（2023确认版为4，20.2%落在15-25%档）。2022年capex/收入=32,040/116,609=27.5%（含融资租赁本金口径，L3547），净购买PP&E口径31,190/116,609=26.7%（L4356），两口径均破25%上限档。收入同比-1%而capex续升，强度抬升由分母恶化与分子扩张叠加；服务器折旧占总折旧62.2%（$5.29B/$8.50B），在建工程$25,052M（+70.6%）尚未计提折旧，折旧假设偏差的杠杆效应处于样本峰值。分数变化（4→5）反映2022为 capex 强度峰值年的真实事实。

对照2023确认版口径→4分（持平）。2022年为元宇宙重投入峰值年：Reality Labs经营亏损$13.72B且公司明示'expect our investments to increase in the future'（L1560）；AI算力军备竞赛已启动，Meta于2022年12月明确以'further advance our efforts around artificial intelligence'为由将数据中心转向下一代设计（L5220-5225），直接承认现有设计被AI需求淘汰；竞争对手（GOOGL/MSFT/AMZN）同步扩产，GPU迭代1-2年。竞争与技术替代压力与2023年同档，维持4分。

comparative_context.meta_2022_positioning_note: META 2022综合4.60（高风险），高于同公司2023确认版4.00，为当前样本最高分。核心结论：2022年是Meta折旧风险的'发生年'——同年完成两次年限延长（利润增厚$693M）与$4.61B重组（含$1.34B数据中心资产废弃），'延长折旧假设'与'提前报废资产'在同一份年报中并存，构成项目最具教学价值的内部矛盾样本。2023确认版的$2.43B减值实质是2022年12月战略转向的延续。

annotation_methodology.scoring_method: Five-dimension weighted scoring (D1 0.25 / D2 0.20 / D3 0.20 / D4 0.20 / D5 0.15), 1-5 integer scale, anchored explicitly to confirmed META 2023 file (4.00): same-anchor dimensions held flat (D1, D5), score moves only where 2022 filing facts differ (D2/D3/D4)
